Information for Newton GenX Schoolboys Football Club

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)

start_date <- today()
end_date <- start_date + months(1)

all_days <- seq(start_date, end_date, by = "day")
saturdays <- all_days[wday(all_days, week_start = 1) == 6]

format_date <- \(d) {
  d |>
    format("%A %B %d, %Y") |>
    str_replace(" 0", " ")
}

fetch_table <- \(url) {
  read_html(url) |>
    html_table() |>
    keep(\(tbl) "Date" %in% names(tbl)) |>
    first()
}

fields <- tribble(
  ~name,            ~url,
  "Brandeis Field", "https://newtonma.myrec.com/info/facilities/area_info.aspx?FacilityID=15013&AreaID=15160",
  "Stadium Field",  "https://newtonma.myrec.com/info/facilities/area_info.aspx?FacilityID=15013&AreaID=15034"
)

tables <- fields |>
  mutate(data = map(url, fetch_table))

saturdays |>
  walk(\(sat) {
    target_date <- format_date(sat)

    all_reservations <- tables |>
      pull(data) |>
      map(\(d) filter(d, Date == target_date)) |>
      bind_rows() |>
      filter(str_detect(Time, "AM")) |>
      select(Event, Time)

    cat(target_date, "\n\n")
    if (nrow(all_reservations) > 0) {
      all_reservations |>
        pwalk(\(Event, Time) cat("  ", Event, " | ", Time, "\n"))
    } else {
      cat("   No morning reservations found.\n")
    }
    cat("\n")
  })
```
